lastObserved.detail: Failed at “Admin Tailwind classes carry the acn prefix” (RunStatus tone 'running', restored by the revert); integration and e2e tests were skipped. The run has since been deleted.

risks.title: CI stays red after the revert
risks.mitigation: Owner decision DEC; until then, run the suites locally before each push.

risks.title: Production schema drift (no migrations)
risks.mitigation: MIG before E4/E5: baseline migration, payload migrate in the deploy step.

risks.title: Preview builds fail without PAYLOAD_SECRET
risks.mitigation: Set the variables for Preview (ENV); the code guard stays reverted.

risks.title: Terminal page widens the attack surface
risks.mitigation: Development only, allow-list, capability check, security review before merge.

risks.title: Integration widgets misconfigured
risks.mitigation: Widgets explain missing keys and Google errors with fix links (adff4e0).

risks.title: Bundle creep from new admin views
risks.mitigation: Server components and next/dynamic; 110 kB JS headroom; add a CI bundle check (QA).

risks.title: Payload 4 timing and rework
risks.mitigation: Readiness checklist; visual suite in CI before P7; stay on 3.9x until v4 is stable.

risks.title: Upstream bug: media folders with trash
risks.mitigation: Folders not enabled; tracked in payloadcms/payload#16327.

risks.title: Lost CI history weakens traceability
risks.mitigation: Keep failed and cancelled runs (or export results) so pass rates can be measured.
